name: video-player
purpose: A native video player with play and pause, seek with time, mute and volume, captions and full screen. It also shows the states of a generated video before it plays: generating (with an optional percentage) and error. It plays the URL the app hands it (https, `blob:` or `data:`) and fetches nothing.
useWhen: A generated or attached video in a chat message or artifact, from generating to playing.
A recorded clip in an app screen.
avoidWhen: A third-party player page (YouTube, Vimeo) → use `embed`.
A stored file of any type → use `file-preview`.
bestPractices: Mark the caption track in the page's language as `default`.
Pass `progress` only when the generator reports one.

props.name: src
props.doc: URL of the video: https, blob or data.

props.name: progress
props.doc: Percent done while generating; unset is indeterminate.
